description: Execute a zero-schema Auto-Guarded HTTP GET/POST request through NullClear's firewall against HTTP 5xx crashes, empty JSON bodies, Cloudflare/soft-paywall traps, and LLM refusal strings (10 free trials/day, then $0.005 USDC via Bazaar). Returns verified payload and executionReceipt, or voids settlement on failure. Do NOT use for plain HTML docs-to-Markdown conversion (use nullclear_read_markdown) or when custom JSON Schema/invariants/failover are needed (use nullclear_execute_escrow).

body.description: Optional serialized JSON request body string for POST requests

url.description: Public HTTPS API or data endpoint URL to fetch with automatic crash, paywall, and refusal guards

name: nullclear_fetch_guarded
